description:
Cause Heronblade Elite to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Heronblade Elite
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater
